##### Project general facts

MAHA Townhouses is an exceptional collection of three- and four-bedroom homes where comfort meets convenience in every detail. Each residence is finely crafted with modern designs and lavishly laid out floor plans, offering ample room to personalize the home exactly the way its owners want. Set amidst serene green surroundings, MAHA offers unmatched exclusivity and peace, making it the perfect place to raise a family and truly live the life you've always imagined.

Residents of MAHA Townhouses enjoy easy access to a state-of-the-art gym, a sparkling swimming pool, and dedicated play areas for the little ones. The wider community adds even more to enjoy, with a boutique hotel, retail outlets, jogging and cycling trails, a carousel, water splash pad, kids' train, outdoor cinema, and regular community events. Together, these amenities create a lively, family-friendly environment where there is always something new to discover.

Inside, every townhouse features an open-layout great room with built-in wardrobes, a dedicated dining area, and abundant natural light throughout. Naturally cool porcelain tiled floors and distinguished fixtures and finishes bring a contemporary style to every space, while high-speed fibre optic connectivity adds everyday convenience. The master bedroom enjoys the luxury of an en-suite bathroom, complemented by a private rear garden, a balcony overlooking the greenery, a maid's room, and a covered garage, creating a truly complete and elegant home.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai.  At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
